sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Civil Aviation Authority Second Amendment Ordinance 1984
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXII OF 1984
ORDINANCE XXII OF 1984
PAKISTAN CIVIL AVIATION AUTHORITY (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the Pakistan Civil Aviation Authority
Ordinance, 1982
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th May, 1984]
No. F. 17 (1)/84-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President in hereby published for general
information.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Pakistan Civil Aviation Authority (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1984.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 11, Ordinance XXX of 1982

ORDINANCE XXII OF 1984
ORDINANCE XXII OF 1984
PAKISTAN CIVIL AVIATION AUTHORITY (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the Pakistan Civil Aviation Authority
Ordinance, 1982
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th May, 1984]
No. F. 17 (1)/84-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President in hereby published for general
information.
2. Amendment of section 11, Ordinance XXX of 1982.--In the Pakistan
Civil Aviation Authority Ordinance, 1982 (XXX of 1982), in section 11, after
subsection (4), the following new subsection shall be added, namely :-
"(5) The
Federal Government Lands and Buildings (Recovery of Posses sion) Ordinance,
1965 (LIV of 1965), shag apply to lands and buildings vesting in the Authority
and for the purpose of such application shall have effect as if reference
therein to the Federal Government included a reference to the Authority.".
